object.description: Setup M: physical Android device with a mock location app selected, fine location permission granted, distance unit kilometre, fixes injected once per second along 59.3000 N moving east. Steps: 1. Select Start. 2. Inject fixes at 3 m/s for 300 s (about 0.9 km). 3. Select Finish. 4. Read Best pace and Average pace on the Summary. Expected: Best pace equals Average pace within 1 s/km.
